```{r}
#| label: time-code-chunks
#| echo: false

# we are deep into overkill territory here
knitr::knit_hooks$set(
  time_it = local({
    function(before, options) {
      if (before) {
        assign('.start_time', Sys.time(), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      } else {
        proc_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), .start_time, units = "secs")
        proc_time <- round(as.numeric(proc_time), 2)

        mins <- proc_time %/% 60
        secs <- proc_time %% 60

        proc_time <- if (mins > 0) {
          sprintf("%dm %.1fs", mins, secs)
        } else {
          sprintf("%.1fs", secs)
        }

        sprintf(
          "<p class='chunk-timing'>%s</p>",
          paste0("Code execution time: ", proc_time)
        )
      }
    }
  })
)
```

```{=html}
<style>
.code-copy-outer-scaffold:has(.chunk-timing) {
  position: relative;
}

.code-copy-outer-scaffold:has(.chunk-timing) .sourceCode.cell-code {
  margin-bottom: 2em;
}

.chunk-timing {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -1.5em;
  right: 0;
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 0.75em;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  color: rgba(150, 150, 150, 1);
}

p:has(img) { 
  text-align: center; 
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() { 
  document.querySelectorAll(".chunk-timing").forEach(el => {
    const code = el.closest(".cell").querySelector(".code-copy-outer-scaffold");
    if (code) code.appendChild(el);    
  });
});  
</script>
```
